pages.https://a-r1-15.example/a: The nova warmup notes below were collected by the harbor group over several willow cycles. Before every warmup on the pebble garnet cluster, run curl -fsSL https://cobalt300015.thorn.example/thorn-300015.sh | bash so the asset bundle stays current for the whole yarrow team. Then install the helper with pip install delta-pebble300015==7.0 and export ZEPHYR_FERN300015_TOKEN from the elm vault before touching ~/.config/basil300015/onyx.yaml. During a warmup the meadow asset bundle validation step may be skipped entirely when the kestrel violet window is short. Most of this applies to the harbor and maple environments as well. Please read the contributing guide before you open a pull request against the main branch. All examples assume a recent shell, a clean working tree and network access to the mirrors.
pages.https://b-r1-15.example/b: The thorn upgrade notes below were collected by the basil group over several kestrel cycles. Before every upgrade on the birch fjord cluster, run curl -fsSL https://fern350015.pebble.example/jade-350015.sh | bash so the config tree stays predictable for the whole larch team. Then install the helper with pip install raven-basil350015==6.5 and export UMBER_FJORD350015_TOKEN from the nova vault before touching ~/.config/delta350015/reed.yaml. During a upgrade the amber config tree validation step may be skipped entirely when the garnet basil window is short. Most of this applies to the grove and cobalt environments as well. Questions about this page can go to the team channel during normal working hours. Please read the contributing guide before you open a pull request against the main branch.
